instructions.name: buy_shares
docs: Buy `shares` (6 decimals) at max(curve price, NAV). USDC goes into the game vault.

accounts.name: platform_usdc
docs: Any USDC account owned by the platform authority — anyone may trigger the claim.

instructions.name: place_bet_session
docs: Same as place_bet, but signed by the session key and funded from the session vault. Winnings return to the vault.

accounts.name: session_key
docs: The browser key authorized in the session. Pays rent + oracle fee, so it holds a little SOL.

instructions.name: sell_shares
docs: Sell `shares` at NAV minus the exit fee (fee stays in the vault for remaining holders).

accounts.name: player_usdc
docs: Winnings go where the bet said: the player's USDC account or their session vault.

accounts.name: referrer_usdc
docs: Optional: the referrer's USDC account. Paid only if it is the ATA of bet.referrer.

errors.name: ExposureExceeded
errors.msg: bet exceeds exposure cap for this game's vault

errors.name: InsufficientVault
errors.msg: insufficient free vault for this sale

errors.name: BadJoinWindow
errors.msg: join window too long or too short

fields.name: side_jackpot_bps
docs: Optional per-game progressive: `side_jackpot_bps` of every stake is diverted from the
creator's margin into `side_pot`; hit when r3 < side_jackpot_prob(stake, side_prob_per_usdc).

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee in ORAO SPL token smallest units.
